scope: one expedited zero-progress retry per explicit tenure
conditional callback-unit cost and ideal startup-count implications

execution.method: source inspection and direct state-transition reasoning

findings.observed: The prose/JSON says first eligible pilot; code instead arms once on the first qualifying incomplete nonfatal zero-accepted pilot, which may follow earlier completed uneconomical pilots.
findings.correction: State first qualifying zero-progress pilot within the tenure, not necessarily first comparison.
findings.source: EntryProbeMemory::retry_zero_progress_once; run result branch guarded by retry_unresolved_entry_once, !enter, !fatal, !success, accepted_steps==0

findings.observed: The code consumes future arming permission when setting used=true and pending=true. pending clears in compared() after successful run return, not before starting the special call.
findings.correction: Use the implemented serial proof: arming irrevocably sets used; completed run clears pending; error terminates; no later qualifying result can rearm until tenure ends.
findings.impact: The one-shot bound remains valid; the described implementation order was inaccurate.

findings.observed: The facade already maps the pre-clamp seed to max(min(seed,batch_remaining),min_step) before native endpoint clipping.
findings.correction: Restrict h_seed>=user_h0 to the seed before the common cap/floor; show the common monotone map and native final landing.
findings.impact: Growth-only relative-to-disabled comparison remains valid; actual native input may be below user h0 because of the shared span cap.

assessments.claim: At most one expedited retry per explicit tenure
assessments.reason: Once a qualifying pilot sets used=true,pending=true, further ordinary execution cannot rearm; pending has first reason priority and is cleared after the next returned comparison; a run error exits. A successful entry ends the explicit tenure. Fresh permission arises only when the memory is reset at tenure change.

assessments.claim: Special callback cost at most B+U+V
assessments.reason: One special invocation plus previously reviewed serial callback-unit ceiling, maximum checked unit, and applicable verification allowance. Not a wall-time or total-pilot-difference guarantee.

assessments.claim: Entry seed does not lower the baseline initial proposal
assessments.reason: entry_pilot_growth_seed returns a mean only for success, positive accepted count, finite mean and mean>opts.h0; caller additionally requires economical entry and nonfatal result. The common facade clamp is monotone and identical when the option is disabled.

assessments.claim: Larger seed does not increase ideal startup attempt count
assessments.reason: Each positive geometric partial sum is monotone in initial h. Rejections and changing physical dynamics are explicitly outside this conclusion.

review_assumptions: Adaptive entry memory enabled; retry option enabled; actual pilot has a positive configured attempt budget
Validated finite positive user initial step
Reused callback-unit cap assumptions apply; concurrent callback work requires the stated in-flight allowance
closeout: Author corrected the prose and machine-readable contracts to the unchanged tested implementation. No code edits, Cargo runs, test reruns, or timing were performed by this review. Prior THEORY_REVIEW files were not edited.
cost_unit_readback: Final clarification verified: B+U+V refers to the ceiling callback-unit accounting, not the broader work proxy including linear solves or elapsed time.
